name: I Got Nothin' Left!
label: Quest
description: I Got Nothin' Left!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm a dwarf fer cryin' out loud, friend! I ain't been designed to fish! I mean look at me! I'm practically made outta stone.
I got nothin' left - ye tapped me out. I've taught ye all I know, flipflop!
Don't ye get it? Ah, fine. I got an ol' friend over on Kalimdor who can help ye out. 'Is name be Nat Pagle, a fine lad. Find him on the islands south o' Theramore. Git goin'!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I've always got room on my island for visitors... I reckon...
